test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.**

I have all the technical and communication skills necessary to crack any interview; it will be _______.

options.text: a storm in a tea cup
a piece of cake for me

solution:
The correct answer is **'a piece of cake for me'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank is: **a piece of cake for me.**
 
• Explanation: The idiom ***"a piece of cake"*** means something that is very easy to do or accomplish. In the context of the sentence, the speaker is confident in their technical and communication skills, believing that they can easily succeed in any interview. Therefore, **"a piece of cake for me" **accurately reflects the speaker's confidence in their abilities.
 
• **Options 1, 2, and 3 **do not convey the sense of ease or confidence implied by the sentence.
 
• Option 1, ***"a storm in a tea cup," ***describes a situation that is blown out of proportion, option 2,*** "a chip on my shoulder,***" refers to harboring resentment or a grudge, and option 3, ***"a hard nut to crack,"*** describes something that is difficult to achieve. Therefore, option 4,*** "a piece of cake for me,"*** is the most appropriate idiom in this context.
